verdict.rationale: The Drive API requires OAuth scopes to be defined in both the Google Cloud console and the app (docs-34). It offers a narrow scope that limits access to only the specific files used with the app (docs-8). Per-file permission roles such as reader or commenter (docs-7, docs-30) could further limit what a delegated identity can do. However, credentials are issued through a Google Cloud OAuth setup rather than a first-class agent credential flow in Drive itself. Missing for 10: evidence of service accounts or per-agent tokens, credential revocation and expiry controls, a documented agent-specific least-privilege workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
